description: This file defines the LoadShedQueueFlowController class, which implements load shedding flow control based on CPU utilization and silo load thresholds within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: LoadShedQueueFlowController
classes.description: Implements a queue flow controller that triggers load shedding based on CPU load or percent of silo load shedding limit.

methods.name: CreateAsPercentOfLoadSheddingLimit
methods.description: Creates a flow controller triggered when CPU reaches a specified percentage of the load shedding limit.

methods.name: CreateAsPercentageOfCPU
methods.description: Creates a flow controller triggered when CPU reaches a specific percentage.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns maximum number of items that can be added to the queue based on current load conditions.
